generated_title: Top 12 AI Offers for Freelancers & Solo Builders (Prototyping/Pre-Production)
generated_summary: This curated list highlights the best AI offers for freelancers and solo developers, focusing on practical utility for prototyping and pre-production. It prioritizes new or updated offers, official sources, and generous free tiers or credits. The selection covers LLM APIs, inference providers, GPU cloud, agent platforms, and multimedia APIs, with a strong emphasis on accessibility for individual creators and small teams without VC backing.
